name: stacksmashing
notes: Community around Thomas Roth's (stacksmashing) YouTube channel on hardware hacking, reverse engineering and security; ~4,600 members. Could not confirm the invite directly on his own site (stacksmashing.net) or official socials, only via third-party Discord-listing sites, so treat as unverified/listed rather than officially confirmed.

name: Cybercademy (Grant Collins)
notes: Community tied to cybersecurity YouTuber/content creator Grant Collins (collinsinfosec), aimed at beginners breaking into the field; English, US.

name: Total Seminars Discord (Mike Meyers)
notes: Run by Mike Meyers of Total Seminars (CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+ courses); hosts study halls for exam prep; English, US.

name: TCM Security Discord (Heath Adams / The Cyber Mentor)
notes: Community around Heath Adams (The Cyber Mentor), CEO of TCM Security, ethical hacking educator and PNPT creator; beginner-to-intermediate pentesting audience; English, US.

name: Cyber Insecurity (Neal Bridges)
notes: Community run by Neal Bridges, ~4500 cybersecurity professionals/beginners of all skill levels, non-toxic mentorship focus; English, US.

name: BleepingComputer
notes: Official Discord chat server for the BleepingComputer news site/forum community; general tech and security news readers, English, global.

name: Guia Anônima
notes: Brazilian information security/hacking education community and Discord run by the Guia Anônima project, covering pentest, Python for security, and CTFs for beginners; lang pt, country BR.

name: HackoonSpace
notes: Brazilian hackerspace/community affiliated with UFSCar (Sorocaba campus), aiming to demystify hacking for students and the public; lang pt, country BR.

name: CyberTalents
notes: Egypt-based global platform for Arab/MENA cybersecurity talent (CTFs, learning, hiring); Discord community ~2,270 members, run by CyberTalents (Cairo). Mixed Arabic/English.

name: Siberatay
notes: Turkish-language tech/cybersecurity/software community and training server run by a Turkish cybersecurity & software outfit; ~4,260 members. Confirmed via Discord invite API.

name: Security | منصة صحيح (Sahih)
notes: Arabic-language IT/programming/cybersecurity educational community, ~11,480 members. Confirmed via Discord invite API (guild name, description, member count).

name: Division Zero (Div0) - Singapore Cybersecurity Community
notes: Singapore's volunteer-driven cybersecurity community ("Div0 Digital Kampung"); ~2,400 members; open to professionals, practitioners, and enthusiasts; English-speaking, Singapore.

name: DownUnderCTF
notes: Largest Australia/Aotearoa-run CTF, aimed at high school and university students, grassroots and beginner-friendly; ~5,000+ Discord members; run by AUNZ cybersecurity students. English.

name: HITCON CTF
notes: Official Discord for HITCON CTF, Taiwan's top hacker conference's flagship 48-hour Jeopardy CTF; international competitors welcome. Mixed Chinese/English.

name: SECCON Beginners (ctf4b)
notes: Official Discord for SECCON Beginners CTF, Japan's entry-level track of the country's largest CTF organizer (SECCON), aimed at first-time CTF players. Primarily Japanese.

name: SecTalks Hobart
notes: Local chapter Discord for SecTalks, a non-profit monthly technical security talks + hands-on CTF meetup network; Hobart, Australia chapter; beginner-accessible in-person/online community.

name: SEKOLAH CYBER
notes: Indonesian-language learning community covering Linux, networking, web security, bug bounty, red/blue team, OSINT, CTF, and AI security for beginners; ~5,000+ members.

name: r/HowToHack Discord
notes: Official Discord for r/HowToHack ('Ask, Answer, Learn' hacking community), open to beginners learning offensive security skills; English, global.

name: r/homelab Discord
notes: Community-run Discord identified in search results as the official companion to r/homelab (~38k members); could not independently confirm sidebar placement because Reddit itself is unreachable from this tool. English, global.
